answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil control by linking each identity to bonded collateral and penalizing correlated equivocation across the swarm: if k identities sign conflicting histories, the joint slash scales as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation. Thus a grove of fake nodes cannot cheaply hide behind a beacon or lagoon; coordination increases shared exposure rather than voting power.
